caption: This drawing depicts a centrally placed object that appears to be a vessel or container mounted on a pedestal base, rendered in shades of black and grey on a light tan background. The object has a wide, circular base that narrows into a slender, tapering stem before expanding into a rounded, bulbous central body with a slight outward lip at the horizontal midpoint. The top of the vessel narrows again, ending in a smaller cap or neck, from which two straight, cylindrical tubes or straws protrude diagonally outward. In the upper left corner of the main drawing, there is a smaller, inset sketch of the same object with hand-drawn dimension lines, indicating approximate height and width in inches. The drawings are outlined with rectangular borders, and the lower right of the inner rectangle contains a signature reading "M. MANGANAROZZI."
title: Whale Oil Lamp
